TGO.note: No rule or authority on AI harms stated.
Voix du Togo builds language tools; no government body's own use of AI stated.
No AI tool in a public sector's system stated; AI in technical teaching is only planned.

facts.fact: Since September 2026 the Togolese government has been testing Voix du Togo, a programme to develop AI tools that understand Ewe, Kabiye and Moba before extending to about fifty national languages, as reported from the Ayre Index.

TGO.note: Only a youth share (44.9%) is given, not the whole population.
The Ayre Think Tank is not named as based in Togo.
No UNESCO share of schools with internet or compulsory computing stated.
